assessment_objectives.objective: the accounts, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and access scenarios for which replay-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is required are defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at a minimum, all privileged accounts and all network access to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that store, process or transmit sensitive / regulated data

assessment_objectives.objective: automated mechanisms enforce replay-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) such that authenticator outputs cannot be reused to authenticate a subsequent session.
where nonces are used, the verifier generates a unique nonce for each authentication attempt and rejects authenticator outputs that reuse a prior nonce.
where one-time challenges are used, the verifier issues a unique challenge for each authentication attempt and rejects responses to previously issued challenges.
where time-synchronous values are used, the verifier accepts each One-Time Password (OTP) value only within its validity window and rejects reuse of a previously accepted value.
where channel binding is used, the authenticator output is cryptographically bound to the authenticated protected channel so that it cannot be replayed over a different channel.
configurations of in-scope authentication mechanisms are reviewed to confirm replay-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) remains enforced.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least quarterly, and upon significant change to the authentication infrastructure
